preconditions.description: The size of the array a is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
Each element in the array a is between 1 and 10^5.
The subarray indices l and r are within the bounds of the array.
The number of distinct integers k is between 1 and 10^5.
The index p is within the bounds of the array.
The new value x is between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output value is -1 if it's impossible to choose k distinct integers, otherwise it's a non-negative integer representing the minimum value of dif.
